description: This file defines a React component for displaying a user's progress timeline in a profile page, including challenges completed, solutions, project previews, and pagination.

methods.name: viewSolution
methods.description: Sets the selected challenge as completedChallenge and opens the solution modal.

methods.name: viewProject
methods.description: Sets the challenge as completedChallenge, updates projectTitle, and opens project preview modal.

methods.name: viewExamResults
methods.description: Sets the challenge as completedChallenge, updates projectTitle, and opens exam results modal.

methods.name: closeSolution
methods.description: Closes the solution modal and clears the selected challenge.

methods.name: firstPage
methods.description: Navigates to the first page of the timeline.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Navigates to the next page of the timeline.

methods.name: prevPage
methods.description: Navigates to the previous page of the timeline.

methods.name: lastPage
methods.description: Navigates to the last page of the timeline.

methods.name: renderViewButton
methods.description: Renders the solution display widget for a challenge.

methods.name: renderCompletion
methods.description: Renders a table row for a completed challenge, including challenge title, link, and completion date.

methods.name: useIdToNameMap
methods.description: Fetches challenge data via GraphQL and maps challenge IDs to display names and paths.
